t: Lebarek birkat hammazon beqol ram, veyeter peratim bebirkat hammazon
s: Lebarek birkat hammazon beqol ram, veyeter peratim bebirkat hammazon, ubo h' seipim: birkat hammazon neemeret bekol lashon, shenneemar "uberakta et Hashem vego'", bekol lashon sheatta mebarek, ki lo chiyyebka hakkatub ella shettebarek "et Hashem eloheka", ubekol lashon sheatta makkir sheatta mebarek "Hashem eloqeka al haaretz hattoba asher natan lak" — tukal lebarek. Abal im eno makkir hallashon — eno yotze yede chobato, vaapillu bilshon haqqodesh, sheen ani qore bo: "uberakta et Hashem eloqeka", kevan sheeno mebin tebot habberaka shemmotzi mippiv (ayyen besiman tl"d be"magen abraham" seip qatan v', vehaynu mishshum debittul saggi balleb, kemo shekkatub be"choq yaaqob" seip qatan y"a, mah sheen ken birkat hammazon tzarik sheyyotzi bispatayv, kedilqamman), veap al pi sheyyodea lemi mebarek, vekavvanato lebarek Hashem betebot ellu. Vekol shekken im lebabo poneh lidbarim acherim bishat amirat habberakot, ap al pi shemmebin leshon haqqodesh. Velaken hannashim veamme haaretz sheenam mebinim leshon haqqodesh — chayyabim lebarek birkat hammazon ballashon shemmebinim velo bilshon haqqodesh. Veken enam yotzeim bishmia mehambarek bilshon haqqodesh bezimmun, ella yebareku leatzman ballashon shemmebinim. Veyesh omerim shebbilshon haqqodesh yotze adam yede chobato ap al pi sheeno mebin hallashon, mah sheen ken bishar leshonot. Velaken hannashim veamme haaretz yotzeim yede chobatam bishmia mehambarek bezimmun bilshon haqqodesh. Veken nohagim, ap al pi sherauy lehachamir kassebara harishona:

Vekol zeh bebirkat hammazon, abal bishar berakot, ben birkat hannehenin ben birkat hammitzvot, vaapillu qiddush leshabbat shehu min hattora — yesh omerim sheyyotze yede chobato bekol lashon apillu eno mebin. Veken behallel. Mah sheen ken bimgilla ubiqriat shema ubitpilla, shebbammegilla neemar bah: "veel hayyehudim kiktabam vekilshonam", lemaet shear leshonot kesheen makkirin, ubiqriat shema neemar: "shema", bekol leshon sheatta shomea, kelomar mebin. Abal im eno mebin hallashon, apillu hu leshon haqqodesh — lo yotze yede chobato, ella im ken hebin venitkavven bepasuq rishon, shead kan mitzvat kavvana, umikkan vaelak mitzvat qeria, umitzvat qeria yakol leqayyem ap sheeno mebin hallashon, kemo behallel umegilla. Veken tepilla, hoil vehakkavvana meakkebet bah apillu bediabad bibraka rishona — dinah kiqriat shema. Abal shear berakot chutz mibbirkat hammazon — en hakkavvana meakkebet bediabad. Veyesh omerim shekkol habberakot hen kebirkat hammazon leinyan zeh, sheeno yotze yede chobato kesheeno mebin hallashon, lepi sebara haacharona bishar leshonot, ulepi sebara harishona apillu bilshon haqqodesh, shekkol mah shettiqqenu chakamim — tiqnu keen shel tora, ukemo shebbebirkat hammazon en ani qore bo: "uberakta et Hashem", kesheeno mebin tebot habberaka, o shellebabo poneh lidbarim acherim — hu haddin bishar berakot lo yatza yede chobat habberaka. Mah sheen ken behallel ubimgilla sheen bahem ella mitzvat qeria leakkeb, kemo biqriat shema mippasuq rishon vaelak — yakol hu gam ken lebarek al qeria zo ap sheeno mebin bilshon haqqodesh, kemo sheam haaretz sheyyodea liqrot battora oleh umebarek aleha betzibbur ap al pi sheeno mebin qeriato, vaapillu bizman hazzeh shehaoleh hu eno qore beatzmo. Abal kol habberakot lo tiqqenu otam kede liqrotan, ella lebarek et Hashem, kemo shekkatub bebirkat hammazon: "uberakta et Hashem eloheka", lepikak im eno mebin hattebot shehen iqqar habberakot, o shellebabo poneh ledabar acher bishat amiratan — lo berak kelum, apillu berak bilshon haqqodesh lepi sebara harishona. (Vetebot iqqar habberaka hen: "baruk", "Hashem", umalkut, veinyan shemmebarek alayv, kegon "bore peri haadama", o "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Veken bebirkot hammitzvot. Abal shear nussach habberaka babberakot haarukkot, vaapillu tebot hamakkebot apillu bediabad, kegon berit vetora bebirkat haaretz, umalkut bet david be"boneh yerushalayim" — en meakkebot ella amiratan velo habanatan, lepi sheen shem beraka alehen lomar shekkevan sheeno mebin eno mebarek Hashem. Abal kol beraka sheppotachat vechotemet be"baruk" — meakkebet habanatah biptichatah ubachatimatah, vaapillu hen berakot rabbot semukot zo lazo, kemo birkat qeriat shema. Veen domot lebirkot hattepilla mibberaka sheniyya vaelak, sheen habanatan meakkebet bediabad, lepi shekkol birk[o]t hattepilla hen mitzva achat, g' rishonot keebed shemmesadder shebach lipne rabbo, vey"g emtzaiyyot keebed shemmebaqqesh peras merabbo, veg' acharonot keebed sheqqibbel merabbo veniptar venotel reshut, velaken i epshar lomar zo belo zo, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"t. Lepikak, kevan shehebin venitkavven bibraka rishona, shehi iqqar siddur shebachayv shel haqqadosh baruk hu — lo hitzriku lachazor ulehitpallel, kevan sheqqiyyem iqqar mitzvat chakamim, shessidder shebachayv shel maqom bepiv ubilbabo bibraka rishona, shezzehu iqqar mitzvat hattepilla, shehare im lo kivven libbo bibraka rishona, ap al pi shekkivven bekol shear hattepilla — lo yatza yede chobato. Abal bebirkot qeriat shema, shekkol achat mitzva bipne atzmah, kemo shennitbaer sham — en habana vekavvana shel zo moelet kelum lezo). Uleinyan halaka, sepeq berakot lehaqel bediabad. Abal lekattechilla tzarik lizzaher meod bekavvanat habberaka, ubiprat bebirkat hammazon, kevan sheyyesh omerim sheapillu bediabad lo yatza:

Lo yebarek adam birkat hammazon belibbo. Veim berak — yatza. Vehu shehotzi bispatayv, ella shebberak belachash kol kak ad shello hishmia leozno ella berak belibbo, abal im lo hotzi bispatayv kelal ella hirher belibbo lebad — lo yatza, shehirhur eno kedibbur. Umikkol maqom, im mechamat choli o ones acher eno yakol lehotzi bispatayv — tzarik leharher belibbo, kemo shehitzriku chakamim lebaal qeri, qodem shebbittelu taqqanat ezra, im en lo mayim litbol, sheyyeharher belibbo birkat hammazon, hoil vehi min hattora. Abal mi shehu anus veeno yakol lehotzi bispatayv shear berakot shehu chayyab bahen middibre soperim — en tzarik leharher belibbo min haddin, kemo shello hitzriku lebaal qeri leharher bedibre tora, shehaya muttar leharher kol hayyom bedibre tora, kevan sheeno yotze yede chobat habberakot behirhur, ella sheap al pi ken yesh lo leharher habberaka shennitchayyeb bah, ki "Hashem yireh lallebab", litten lo sekar hammachashaba, ukemo shekkatub "imru bilbabkem vego'". (Veken yaaseh hacholeh apillu bibraka shello nitchayyeb bah, ella shemmebi atzmo lide chiyyub, kegon birkat hannehenin. Abal habbari shehu anus veeno yakol lebatte bispatayim mippene hammaqom sheeno naqi, beinyan sheasur ledabber umuttar leharher, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"b, o mippene ones acher — lo yehaneh meolam hazzeh belo beraka, ap al pi shemmeharher oto belibbo, kevan sheeno yotze yede chobato behirhur bediabad). Veyesh omerim, shekkol habberakot, apillu birkat hammazon, yotze adam yede chobato behirhur bediabad, veenan domot liqriat shema, shenneemar bah: "vedibbarta bam", vehirhur eno kedibbur, abal bebirkat hammazon lo neemar "vedibbarta", ella "uberakta", vehambarek belibbo — gam ken shem beraka aleha. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bishar berakot shehen middibre soperim — yesh lismok al zeh bishat haddechaq uletzorek gadol:

Baal habbayit sheokel im banayv haqqetannim shehiggiu lechinnuk birkat hammazon veenan yodeim lebarek, o im ishto sheenah yodaat lebarek — tzarik lebarek beqol ram kede sheyyishmeu veyetzeu yede chobatan, ap al pi sheenam mezammenim alehem. Vetob sheyyomru immo milla bemilla, lepi shei epshar lekavven velishmoa, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"g (veken beqiddush vehabdala):

Ap al pi sheshshetuy yayin asur bitpilla ad sheyyasir yeno mealayv, ap al pi sheyyakol ledabber lipne hammelek veeno mishtabbesh, kemo shennitbaer besiman tz"t — mebarek hu birkat hammazon, kol sheyyakol ledabber lipne hammelek, apillu eno yakol ledabber karauy, shemmedabber venikkar middibburo shehu shatuy, ella sheeno nikshal umishtabbesh, shenneemar "veakalta vesabota uberakta vego'", veachar sebia peamim shehu shatuy, veap al pi ken chiyyeba oto hattora lebarek. Abal im hu shikkor sheeno yakol ledabber lipne hammelek belo shibbush — yesh omerim sheeno mebarek birkat hammazon, shebbirkat shikkor toeba kemo shettepillato toeba, kemo shennitbaer besiman tz"t. Veim berak — yesh lehistappeq im tzarik lachazor ulebarek kesheyyapig yeno beod shello nitakkel hammazon shebbemeayv, kemo shehitzriku bitpilla lachazor ulehitpallel kesheyyapig yeno, kevan shebbirkat hammazon enah chamura kol kak kemo tepilla, shehare shatuy muttar lekattechilla bebirkat hammazon velo bitpilla. Veken yesh lehistappeq bemi shebberak birkat hammazon veachar kak matza tzoa kenegdo o betziddo tok d' ammot bemaqom sherauy lehistappeq bo betzoa vetzarik lebodqan qodem sheyyebarek sham upasha velo badaq, beinyan shebbitpilla tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel, mishshum shenneemar "zebach reshaim toeba", kemo shennitbaer besiman a"v, im hechemiru gam ken bebirkat hammazon lehatzriko lachazor ulebarek mishshum peshiuto, kevan shebbirkat hammazon enah chamura kemo tepilla leinyan shatuy. (Umikkan atta lamed, shehashshatuy gam ken asur biqriat shema kemo bitpilla, shehare mi sheqqara qeriat shema bemaqom sherauy lehistappeq bo betzoa — hitzrikuhu lachazor veliqrot kemo shehitzrikuhu bitpilla, kemo shennitbaer besiman a"v. Ubirkot qeriat shema hen kiqriat shema atzmah). Veken yesh lehistappeq im pasaq beemtza birkat hammazon apillu bishtiqa veshaha kede ligmor et kullah mechamat ezeh ones, im tzarik lachazor lerosh kemo shehitzrikuhu bitpilla ledibre hakkol (hoil vehi chamura kitpilla leinyan hapsaqa, sheen mapsiqin bah mippene hayyira vehakkabod, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"g, o shemma kevan sheenah chamura kitpilla leinyan shatuy, veken leinyan hapsaqa bediabad, shello hitzrikuhu lachazor lerosh bebirkat hammazon kemo shehitzrikuhu bitpilla, yesh lomar shehu haddin im shaha kede ligmor et kullah). (Usepeq berakot lehaqel, sheap shebbirkat hammazon min hattora, mikkol maqom, zeh sheyyitztarek lachazor lerosh ulebarek, mishshum shebbirkat shikkor toeba, o mishshum she"zebach reshaim toeba", sheppasha velo badaq hammaqom, o mishshum sheshshaha kede ligmor et kullah mechamat ones velo birtzono — eno ella middibrehem). Veyesh omerim apillu shikkor sheeno yakol ledabber lipne hammelek kelal — mebarek birkat hammazon, shenneemar "vesabota uberakta", veachar hassebia peamim shehu shikkor. Ulekattechilla yesh lachosh lassebara harishona ulebarek qodem shebba lide kak. Veim era shennishtakker — ap al pi ken yebarek birkat hammazon kassebara haacharona, ki hu sapeq shel tora ulehachamir. Ulepi sebara haacharona, gam biqriat shema ubirkoteha lo niptar hashshatuy, ella hashshikkor lebaddo, ki mah shehechemiru bahen lachazor veliqrot kesheppasha velo badaq hammaqom velo hechemiru ken bebirkat hammazon, eno mishshum shehen chamurot mimmenna leinyan shatuy, ella leinyan shikkor lebad. Lepikak, lekattechilla yesh lachosh lassebara harishona, veim era sheshshata — lo yimmana miqqeriat shema, mippene shehu sapeq shel tora, vekol haqqore qeriat shema apillu missapeq — tzarik liqroto bebirkotayv, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"z. Ushear kol habberakot kullan yakol lebarek ap al pi shehu shikkor, kemo shennitbaer besiman tz"t. Veap lehaomerim shehakkavvana meakkebet bekol habberakot, mikkol maqom, hashshikkor yesh lo kavvana, shehare hu kepiqqeach lekol dabar, ulekol onashin shebbattora dino kemitkavven, kemo shekkatub bechoshen mishpat siman rl"h. Ella liqriat shema velitpilla shehen tzerikot kavvana meulla — en kavvanat hashshikkor chashuba kavvana, vetoeba hi, kevan shehi meshubbeshet, shehare eno yakol ledabber lipne hammelek belo shibbush, abal bishar berakot day bekavvana kol shehu, ap al pi shehi meshubbeshet:
